info.title: Imobzi REST API
info.description:
# Introduction Imobzi provides a web programming interface, in the REST model. Through this interface, you can talk to the Imobzi Application, commanding actions and synchronizing with your applications. The base communication address is api.imobzi.app, always followed by the secure protocol https:// as a prefix. API versions are grouped by directory, suffixed to the base address (https://api.imobzi.app/v1). This document covers the version of API 1.0. The address to communicate through this release is: ``` https://api.imobzi.app/v1/ ``` # Authentication Authentication on Imobzi is done through the use of a secret key. This key is for the Imobzi API to identify your account, and grant permissions for an Application to communicate with Imobzi. ## Creating your Secret Key Create your secret key by following the steps below. You must have administrator access.
  1. Access Imobzi at https://my.imobzi.com or if you are already logged in click here.
  2. Click the 'Integrations and Automations' menu. Now click in the 'API Keys' tab and click on the 'New' button and enter the name of the Application that will use the generated key. Copy the key and click 'Save'.
## Authentication Test After generating your key, if desired, test authentication with this command line in Curl: ```curl curl --request GET --url https://api.imobzi.app/v1/properties --header 'X-Imobzi-Secret:34afddae1a7c11e9a10bab89456f8c3b' ``` ## Sandbox Currently the API does not have a Sandbox available for testing. We recommend that you carefully create, update and delete data. # Webhooks Webhooks allow your application to receive notifications when certain events occur. For example, when a new Contact is created, Imobzi will make a POST request to your URI endpoint letting you know information about the new Contact. You can create Webhooks through the API using the Webhooks creation method below. Webhooks are the recommended way to be notified about creating, changing, and removing a record in Imobzi, as they are easier to integrate with your application and scale perfectly with your growth.

Delivery attempts

Every time a record is created, updated and deleted, Imobzi will fire the created Webhook immediately. If the Status different from 20X returns, the Imobzi will fire this Webhook 5 more times, will be respectively in 10, 20, 40, 80, 160 minutes.

Notification format

The Webhook endpoint will receive a POST request, containing a JSON object encoded in UTF-8. This object usually contains the complete record, avoiding a request to obtain the rest of the data. The format of the JSON object can be obtained at the first Webhook request.

List of available Webhooks

Event Description
deal_created When a new deal is Created
deal_updated When a deal is Updated
deal_deleted When a deal is Deleted
document_created When a Document is Created
document_updated When a Document is Updated
document_deleted When a Document is Deleted
lead_created When a new Lead is Created
lead_updated When a Lead is Updated
lead_deleted When a Lead is Deleted
contact_created When a new Person/Organization is Created
contact_updated When a Person/Organization is Updated
contact_deleted When a Person/Organization is Deleted
property_created When a new Property is Created
property_updated When a Property is Updated
property_deleted When a Property is Deleted
property_reserve_created When a Property Reserve is Created
property_reserve_updated When a Property Reserve is Updated
property_reserve_deleted When a Property Reserve is Deleted
pipeline_group_created When a Pipeline Group is Created
calendar_item_created When a new Item Calendar is Created
calendar_item_updated When a Item Calendar is Updated
calendar_item_deleted When a Item Calendar is Deleted
lease_created When a Lease is Created
lease_updated When a Lease is Updated
lease_deleted When a Lease is Deleted
contract_created When a Contract is Created
contract_updated When a Contract is Updated
contract_deleted When a Contract is Deleted
invoice_created When a Invoice is Created
invoice_updated When a Invoice is Updated
financial_transaction_created When a Financial Transaction is Created
financial_transaction_updated When a Financial Transaction is Updated
financial_transaction_deleted When a Financial Transaction is Deleted
analysis_created When a Analysis is Created
analysis_updated When a Analysis is Updated
analysis_deleted When a Analysis is Deleted
# Pagination The first time a list request is executed, the API will generally return 50 records and the cursor to the next 50 records that must be sent on the next request using the cursor parameter. The number of records returned per request varies according to the method to be consumed. The cursor parameter is optional and should not be sent on the first request. # Rate limiting Imobzi has some different rate limits to ensure that any client can not affect the performance of our API by making too many requests too quickly.
Scope Rate-limit
Application 120 requests per minute
Account 300 requests per minute

Timeout Limit

If a request does not complete within 60 seconds, the request times out and Imobzi returns a Gateway Timeout error.

get.description: Search and list deals using optional filters. All filters are optional — call with no filters to list recent deals with defaults. Returns paginated results. Combine filters for precision. To find a single deal by code, pass deal_code + pipeline_group_name. Approximate pipeline names are accepted (backend resolves or disambiguates). Read-only: this tool only searches and lists data.

post.description: Create a new deal in the CRM. Requires title, pipeline_group_name, and stage_name. Optionally associate a contact by email or name and set value/interest. No internal IDs needed. contact_email preferred over contact_name for precision. Write operation: creates a new deal. Use search tool to find existing ones.

put.description: Update fields of an existing deal by code. Accepted code formats: numeric (e.g. 123) or prefixed (e.g. IM-123). For numeric code, provide pipeline_group_name to identify the funnel. For prefixed code, funnel is resolved by prefix. Only include the fields you want to change — omitted fields remain unchanged. Stage changes use stage_name (e.g. 'Proposta Enviada'). Write operation: modifies an existing deal. Use search tool to find deals first.

delete.description: Permanently delete a deal by code. Accepted code formats: numeric (e.g. 123) or prefixed (e.g. IM-123). For numeric code, provide pipeline_group_name to identify the funnel. For prefixed code, funnel is resolved by prefix. This action is irreversible and will permanently delete the deal. Requires explicit user confirmation.

initial_date.title: Initial Date
initial_date.description: Absolute start datetime in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS). The informed clock time is interpreted in America/Sao_Paulo, with or without a suffix. Use ONLY when the user provides an explicit date (e.g. '03/06/2026 às 9h'). For relative expressions ('amanhã', 'hoje', 'próxima segunda') use relative_initial_date + initial_time instead. Either initial_date OR relative_initial_date must be provided.

relative_initial_date.title: Relative Initial Date
relative_initial_date.description: Relative day/date expression for the start date. The backend resolves this deterministically using current date/time in America/Sao_Paulo (no LLM guessing). Preferred canonical values: today, tomorrow, day_after_tomorrow, next_monday, next_tuesday, next_wednesday, next_thursday, next_friday, next_saturday, next_sunday, next_week, end_of_week, end_of_month, next_month_same_day. Also accepts natural Portuguese expressions like: 'amanhã', 'depois de amanhã', 'próxima segunda', 'segunda-feira', 'semana que vem', 'fim do mês', 'daqui a 2 dias às 8h30'. Use together with initial_time when the time is not included in this expression.

initial_time.title: Initial Time
initial_time.description: Time component for the start datetime in HH:MM (24h) format. Use together with relative_initial_date. Examples: '09:00', '14:30', '8h' → '08:00', '9h' → '09:00'. If omitted, defaults to 09:00.

title.title: Título do negócio
title.description: Title of the deal. REQUIRED. Should be a short, descriptive label for the business opportunity. If the user does not provide a title, generate one automatically as 'Novo Negócio - {contact_name}'. Example values: 'Venda Apt 302 - João Silva', 'Locação Sala Comercial Centro'.

pipeline_group_name.title: Nome do funil
pipeline_group_name.description:
Nome do funil (PipelineGroup) ao qual o negócio pertence. OBRIGATÓRIO.

ONTOLOGIA — dois campos distintos:
  • pipeline_group_name = FUNIL = categoria/gaveta que agrupa negócios. Ex.: 'Vendas', 'Locação', 'Vendas & Locação'.
  • stage_name = ETAPA = passo dentro do funil. Ex.: 'Novo Lead', 'Proposta', 'Fechamento'.
Nunca coloque etapa aqui; nunca coloque funil em stage_name.

VOCABULÁRIO DO USUÁRIO → valor a enviar (apenas o nome, sem prefixo 'Funil'):
  'funil de Vendas', 'no funil Vendas' → 'Vendas'
  'Funil de Vendas & Locação', 'funil Vendas & Locação' → 'Vendas & Locação'
  'funil de Locação' → 'Locação'
  NUNCA envie 'Funil', 'Funil de', 'Funil do' como parte do valor.

O backend faz busca exata; se não encontrar, retorna lista de opções para escolha.

stage_name.title: Nome da etapa
stage_name.description:
Nome da ETAPA (Pipeline) dentro do funil onde o negócio começa. OBRIGATÓRIO.

Etapa ≠ Funil: etapa é um passo DENTRO do funil (pipeline_group_name). São campos DISTINTOS — nunca coloque nome de funil aqui.
Vocabulário: 'etapa', 'fase', 'passo', 'coluna', 'estágio' → preencha ESTE campo.

Etapas são ordenadas: ex. 'Novo Lead' → 'Visita Agendada' → 'Proposta' → 'Fechamento'.
Se o usuário não especificar a etapa, envie 'primeira etapa' — o backend resolve automaticamente para a primeira etapa do funil sem perguntar ao usuário.
Se o usuário especificar uma etapa que não existe, o backend retorna etapas válidas do funil para o usuário escolher.

Exemplos: 'Novo Lead', 'Visita Agendada', 'Proposta Enviada', 'Negociação', 'Fechamento'.

value.title: Valor do negócio
value.description: Monetary value of the deal in BRL (Brazilian Reais). REQUIRED. Send as a plain number WITHOUT currency symbols or thousand separators. Use dot as decimal separator. If the user does not specify a value, send 0. For rent deals this is the monthly rent value. For buy deals this is the total sale price. Example values: 0, 350000.00, 2500.50, 1200000.

interest.title: Interesse do negócio
interest.description: Type of business interest for this deal. Defaults to 'buy'. Send one of the exact slug values — NOT Portuguese. Translation map: compra / venda → 'buy', aluguel / locação → 'rent', temporada / aluguel por temporada → 'vacation_rental'. If interest is 'vacation_rental', the fields vacation_start and vacation_end become required.

vacation_start.title: Início da temporada
vacation_start.description: Start date of the vacation rental period. REQUIRED when interest='vacation_rental', ignored otherwise. Format: ISO 8601 datetime string. Example: '2026-11-20T00:00:00.000Z'.

vacation_end.title: Fim da temporada
vacation_end.description: End date of the vacation rental period. REQUIRED when interest='vacation_rental', ignored otherwise. Must be after vacation_start. Format: ISO 8601 datetime string. Example: '2026-11-30T00:00:00.000Z'.

description.title: Descrição do negócio
description.description: Free-text notes or additional details about the deal. Can include property preferences, client requirements, negotiation context, etc. No format restrictions. Example: 'Cliente procura apartamento 3 quartos, vista para o mar, orçamento máximo de 500 mil'.

contact_email.title: E-mail do contato
contact_email.description: Email of the contact (person or organization) to link to this deal. The backend searches for the contact by email in ElasticSearch and auto-detects whether it is a Person or Organization. Prefer this over contact_name — it is more precise and avoids ambiguity when multiple contacts share similar names. If both contact_email and contact_name are provided, both are used in the search (AND logic). Format: user@domain.com. Example: 'joao.silva@gmail.com'.

contact_name.title: Nome do contato
contact_name.description: Full name of the contact to link to this deal. Used as FALLBACK when contact_email is not available. The backend searches by name in ElasticSearch. Must match exactly one contact — if multiple contacts match, the backend returns an error listing them for disambiguation. Example values: 'João Silva', 'Construtora ABC Ltda'.

contact_phone.title: Telefone do contato
contact_phone.description: Phone number of the contact to link to this deal. Used as an additional filter to identify the contact when email or name are not sufficient. The backend searches by this field in ElasticSearch. Must match exactly one contact. Format: 11 91234-5678. Example: '11 91234-5678'.

contact_legal_identification.title: Identificação legal do contato
contact_legal_identification.description: Legal identification of the contact, such as CPF for individuals or CNPJ for companies. Used as an additional filter to identify the contact when email or name are not sufficient. The backend searches by this field in ElasticSearch. Must match exactly one contact. Example values: '123.456.789-00' for CPF, '12.345.678/0001-00' for CNPJ.

contact_code.title: Código interno do contato
contact_code.description: Internal contact code injected automatically by the runtime when a contact was created or identified in the same session. Do NOT populate this field manually — it is used as a transactional bypass to avoid ElasticSearch replication lag when the contact was just created in the preceding tool call. Example values: '12345', 'CON-001'.

pipeline_group_stable_id.title: ID estável do funil
pipeline_group_stable_id.description: Internal Firestore document ID of the pipeline group, injected automatically by the runtime during stage disambiguation. Do NOT populate this field manually. When present, it bypasses the name-based pipeline group lookup so that a retry after stage disambiguation always resolves the same funnel regardless of any inconsistency between the user-provided name and the database.

status.description: Change the deal status. Send one of the exact values below. Use exactly: 'in progress', 'win', 'lost', 'stagnant', 'out_of_date'. Translation map from Portuguese: em andamento / reabrir → 'in progress', ganho / ganhou / fechado → 'win', perdido / perdeu → 'lost', estagnado / parado → 'stagnant', atrasado / vencido → 'out_of_date'.
